name: Ollama Cloud + DeepSeek
description: Dual-provider adapter — hardcoded catalog of Ollama Cloud and DeepSeek models, selectable from the onboarding wizard and agent-creation UI

model.description: Model id — Ollama Cloud (e.g. gpt-oss:120b-cloud) or deepseek/ prefixed

ollamaApiKey.description: Ollama Cloud API key. Falls back to OLLAMA_API_KEY env var.

deepseekApiKey.description: DeepSeek API key. Falls back to DEEPSEEK_API_KEY env var.
